The Raspberry Pi and Pololu link excerpts are normalized from the official
resource pointers used by the bundled catalog (Pololu checked live 2026-10-29).
Other providers use negative fixtures: no exact public downloadable model was
located for the requested board. These test graceful misses without inventing
CAD URLs. Onshape responses are synthetic public/private transport contract
fixtures; they are not evidence of a live import.
